name: Nathan Ashford
original_name: ナータン アッシュフォード
source:
One of the masters at the Ashford residence. Being a noble, he's very proud and doesn't speak much, but treasures his family a lot. Everyday he stays inside the villa and never intends to go out.

[From [url=http://www.roseverte.net/cafe0/beast/en]Official Website's Characters Page[/url]]
